title: Concurrent sessions in one worktree cross-attribute working-tree edits to each other's task records
observation: The working-tree half of gitTouchedFiles attributes any modified/untracked file whose mtime falls in the task window, with no link to the session that edited it. Two Claude Code sessions open on the same checkout at once (common: one coding, one researching) each get the other's files. Observed 2026-09-16: a research-only prompt (no edits, no tool-instrumented delivery on code) got a private task record listing src/serve/mcpHttp.ts, a file being edited by a different session on branch feat/serve-mcp-http during its window (file mtime 13:31Z, window 13:10Z-13:32Z). The ranking then relates that research task to later work on mcpHttp.ts.
